messages:
Nadia (CS): Sharing a compact "priming recipe" for go-live handoffs aimed at smaller enterprise customers. Purpose: predictable latency, minimal cold starts, and a simple renewal-signal capture. Pasteable snippets below.
Omar (Solutions): This looks useful. can we include one-sentence explanations so customer engineers know why each knob exists?
Nadia (CS): yes 80: soft_step prefill ramps traffic gently to avoid synchronized spikes; micro-batches keep UI feel snappy; streaming enabled for progressive UI updates.
Felix (Infra): infra recommendations: default micro_batch_ms=30, max_batch_tokens=160. add randomized prefill jitter (0-250ms) across tenants. warm-pool target: 1-4 nodes depending on expected peak_qps.
Nadia (CS): customer-ready client config (copy/paste):
```json
{"prefill":true,"prefill_strategy":"soft_step","prefill_seconds":28,"batch_window_ms":30,"max_batch_tokens":160,"stream":true,"heartbeat_s":20}
```
Gwen (PM): add a tiny rollout safety: run a 12-prompt smoke eval 24h after go-live and when model routing changes; if >2 regressions, route to fallback variant and notify CS.
Ravi (Research): renewal signal idea: combine short-term telemetry + qualitative pulse. signals: sudden session drop (>40%), sustained p95 latency >1.5x, negative survey or flagged hallucination. tag account "at_risk" and schedule 48-72h outreach.
Warmup-bot: Scheduled: warm-pool prewarm for tag "go-live-priming" at 02:00 UTC tomorrow.
Felix (Infra): ops troubleshooting checklist to share with SEs: 1) confirm client heartbeat 2) curl SSE endpoint to verify events 3) search logs for x-request-id and stream disconnects. Example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/health?model=xyz`.
Omar (Solutions): sample traffic profile for SRE handoff (explain fields): `peak_qps` (worst-case qps), `avg_tokens` (avg tokens per request), `interactive` (UI-like), `session_s` (median session length). Example payload:
```json
{"peak_qps":6,"avg_tokens":48,"interactive":true,"session_s":90}
```
Nadia (CS): operational play: send 48h pulse survey (3 Qs: accuracy likert, latency ok Y/N, hallucinations Y/N+example). negative -> open ticket + tag renewal risk. schedule 72h CS check for amber/red accounts.
Gwen (PM): let's add short SLA language in the playbook so CS gives consistent expectations. I'll draft and attach.
Nadia (CS): thanks all  I'll publish as "Priming recipe: microbatch + stream" in the playbook and set a 20m walkthrough with CS+SE next Tue. Closing thread and moving items into the doc. /end
